News Application Documentation¶

This Django application allows journalists to write articles and newsletters, editors to review content, and readers to manage subscriptions.

User roles¶

  • Readers: view approved articles and newsletters, and manage subscriptions to publishers and independent journalists.

  • Journalists: create articles and newsletters, and update or delete their own content.

  • Editors: review and approve articles, update or delete content, and manage publishers. Editors cannot create newsletters.

Article workflow¶

  1. A journalist creates an article.

  2. An editor reviews and approves it.

  3. Subscribers receive an email notification.

  4. If the journalist edits the article, it requires approval again.

Code reference¶

The following sections display documentation from the project’s Python modules, classes, and functions.

Views¶

Handle browser requests for the news application.

Provide registration, role-specific dashboards, article review, newsletter management, publisher management, and reader subscriptions.

Views enforce role and ownership restrictions. Article approval and deletion require POST requests with CSRF protection.

Models¶

Database models for the news application.

class news_app.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Store an article written by a journalist.

Each article records its author, content, publication timestamps, and approval status. An optional publisher identifies publisher content; a blank publisher identifies independent journalism.

Articles require editor approval before appearing in public feeds.

Subscription queries¶

Queries shared by reader pages and the API.

news_app.selectors.subscribed_articles(user)[source]¶

Return approved articles matching a reader’s subscriptions.

Include articles from subscribed publishers and independent articles from subscribed journalists. Exclude unapproved articles and remove duplicate results.

Parameters:

user – The reader whose subscriptions determine the results.

Returns:

Approved articles with author and publisher details.

Return type:

QuerySet
